meta.generator: MIT RecklessMagics (codedeliveryservice/RecklessMagics) + goutham/magic-bits — offline, no GPL table copy
meta.shiftType: per-square fancy (64 - popcount(mask)), Fancy Magic plain fixed-shift optimized for size (ADR-012)
meta.note: Per-square mask/magic/shift/offset + flat attack table. Index = ((occ & mask) * magic >> shift) + offset. Occupancy & mask masked before multiply. Table entries are SquareSet {lo,hi} attack bitboards. Generated offline via MIT RecklessMagics Rust crate (pure Rust, no GPL), verified against correct sliding attacks (FIDE). Not copied from chessops/Stockfish. Uniform shift 11 baseline was 8192 entries; per-square reduces to rook 102400 bishop 5248 (Fancy) but still Black Magic plain fixed-shift wins 441% vs HQ.
meta.tableFormat: table: legacy flat Uint32Array of low 32 bits (for harness, size 102400/5248); attackTable: flat array of {lo,hi} SquareSet objects (correct 64-bit, for purechess impl). Magics: magic is low32 for harness, magicHex is full 64-bit.
